# v1.4.0 — Tiered outline injection: every stage stays inside its lane

> **zread-pi 1.4.0**: the three blueprint stages now carry a progressively refined outline,
> and each stage treats the previous one's output as a hard boundary. Sections declare what they
> **do not** cover, topics declare what a single article proves, and page prompts inherit both —
> the whole wiki no longer drifts across sections.

## ✨ New capabilities

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| **Section scope (negative boundary)** | The classify stage must give every section a `scope`: 1–3 "Contains: …" entries plus 1–3 "Excludes: … (→ neighbour section)" entries, forming a mutual-exclusion contract between sections |
| **Topic summary (range anchor)** | Each topic carries a one-sentence `summary` (≤40 chars): what the article argues and which files back it up |
| **Tiered injection** | The topics stage receives the section scope; the titles stage receives the scope plus a "do not cross the section boundary" rule; page prompts receive `topicSummary` + a scope-discipline line alongside `title` / `section` / `associatedFiles` |
| **Sync carries anchors verbatim** | The sync topics stage lists existing page summaries and requires them to be returned verbatim, so page anchors never drift |

## 🔧 Behavior differences (intentional)

- All fields are **optional** (`WikiSection.scope?`, `WikiTopic.summary?`, `WikiPage.topicSummary?`):
  old `wiki.json` files keep working, and a missing field simply means "no boundary".
- Base sections (`Overview` / `Quick Start` / `Core Architecture`) keep their forced title/description,
  but now adopt the model-declared `scope`.
- No code-level boundary validation: scope/summary are semantic constraints that cannot be judged
  mechanically, so only the "inject + prompt constraint" layer exists (quantity control keeps its
  four-layer defence because it is mechanical).
- `computeSyncDiff` ignores the new fields; status is still computed from title / group / level / associatedFiles.

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.4.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <target-repo>
```

# v1.4.0 —— 三阶段大纲逐级注入（scope / summary 防全项目漂移）

> **zread-pi 1.4.0**：蓝图三阶段现在各自携带逐级细化的大纲，上一级产物是下一级的硬边界——
> 分类声明**不覆盖**什么，主题声明一篇文章论证什么，页面提示词同时继承两者，
> 全站不再跨分类漂移。

## ✨ 新能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **分类 scope（负向边界）** | 分类阶段必须为每个分类给出 `scope`：1~3 条「包含：…」+ 1~3 条「不包含：…（→ 相邻分类）」，形成分类间的互斥契约 |
| **主题 summary（范围锚点）** | 每个主题带一句话 `summary`（≤40 字）：这篇文章论证什么、以哪些文件为证据 |
| **逐级注入** | 分主题阶段拿到本分类 scope；标题阶段拿到 scope + 「不越出分类边界」规则；页面提示词在 `title` / `section` / `associatedFiles` 之外拿到 `topicSummary` 与一行范围纪律 |
| **同步逐字带回锚点** | sync 的分主题阶段列出既有页面 summary 并要求逐字保留，页面锚点不漂移 |

## 🔧 行为差异（有意为之）

- 新字段全部**可选**（`WikiSection.scope?` / `WikiTopic.summary?` / `WikiPage.topicSummary?`）：旧 `wiki.json` 照常工作，缺字段即「无边界」。
- 基础分类（`概览` / `快速开始` / `核心架构`）保留强补 title/description，但会采纳模型声明的 `scope`。
- 不做代码级越界校验：scope / summary 是语义约束，无法机械判定，因此只有「注入 + 提示词约束」一层（数量控制可机械判定，才保留四层防线）。
- `computeSyncDiff` 不感知新字段；页面状态仍由 title / group / level / 关联路径机械判定。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.4.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <目标仓库>
```
